confirm.title: Mark resolved
confirm.message: Like watering this connection once. You don't have to forgive yet — just mark that you're tending this feeling. Ready?

ceremony.title: Planting peace
ceremony.body: No need to forgive yet — let your heart soften a little…

confirm.title: Burn it out
confirm.message: Turn these heated words to smoke? You'll keep an ash trace, but the words won't come back.

complete.message: Those words have drifted away — take a breath
